completion.limitation: Task-only traced cost diagnostic; no selector, route, numerical acceptance, or performance qualification.

scientific_scope.arithmetic: Arithmetic-preserving read-only observer; exact scientific bits and solver signatures required.
scientific_scope.comparator: Maintained scripts/replay_plugins.py exact_view(False), plus full binary publication-column SHA256 equality.
scientific_scope.excluded: Only the maintained telemetry exclusions: RMEMORY, non-signature RRUNTIME rows, and RSOLVER timing columns. All matrices are retained here including excluded telemetry.

geometry_math.domain: Three validated nonempty intercept effects, true unit weights, 0<N<=i32::MAX; fallible one-bank admission; unsupported/overflow/allocation cases abstain without changing original Auto fit.
geometry_math.centering: Every pair removes the same global constant only. Extra disconnected/pair intersections are retained; no extra component subtraction.
geometry_math.coherence_bound: mu_ij <= min(1,sqrt(S/(N^2*min(n_a)*min(n_b)))); integer casts, division, square root and positive recurrence operations are outward enclosed.
geometry_math.symmetric_sweep: R1 R2 R3 R2 R1; at P1v=0, let a=mu12,b=mu13,c=mu23,u=a+bc+ac^2,v=b+ac. B=[[a*u,a*v],[c^3+b*u,c^2+b*v]] bounds remaining block moments.
geometry_math.four_sweep_bound: max(B^4*[1,1]) times the original RHS norm bounds the local certificate in exact arithmetic. No floating solve guarantee and no LSMR iteration prediction.
geometry_math.independent_review: Independent high-effort review accepted exact integer moments, common centering, outward rounding, 2x2 recurrence and scratch lifetime before native pricing.

cost_semantics.feature_s: Allocation and initialization, marginal scan, three counting/clearing passes, bounds and deallocation; excludes adapter dispatch and trace formatting/writes.
cost_semantics.adapter_s: Observer dispatch plus inspect; excludes trace writes.
cost_semantics.including_prior_output_s: Includes earlier geometry trace writes, excludes its own closing write; native whole-fit timing includes that write.
cost_semantics.scratch: Actual allocated u64 capacity, checked against remaining admitted memory and dropped before original solver setup; public RMEMORY remains the original fit report.
cost_semantics.work: Each actual observer call counts3N and clears3N entries, plus marginal scans. One serial lane even at16 workers.
cost_semantics.reference_ratios: Geometry clocks from scc-gd4 normalized by earlier scc-gr4 Auto captures. Hosts and times differ; these are accounting comparisons, not an observed causal regression or qualification test.
cost_semantics.hypothetical_reuse: One-feature columns price only one observed feature construction. No cache was implemented or priced. Existing initial certification may avoid residual geometry; acceptance/setup cost remains to be accounted.

matrix_encoding: wire_matrix_ref is SHA256 of sorted compact JSON with rows,columns,ieee64_hex. Contiguous16-digit IEEE754 encodings preserve every original bit; all full-wire matrices roundtrip exactly.

failed_setup.status: rustfmt/rustc missing from initial shell PATH left no standalone probe; Python invocation failed before any feature case. Repaired using the installed1.85.1 absolute toolchain paths; no scientific repair.

witnesses.final_method: Exact-rational contingency numerator and explicit dense rational residual-maker matrices, independent of probe cancellation identity and recurrence; eight geometries and two admission cases, assertions explicitly enabled.

reproduction.method: Apply-check then apply to pristine exact-base archive; every reviewed source and frozen tool hash matched.

decision.outcome: Stop; no selector and no new holdout under this diagnostic.
decision.measured: One observed geometry feature construction is within the sparse reference allowance. Recomputing features for both dense16-worker calls costs more than5% of priorAuto time. Neither observation establishes a complete candidate route cost.
identifiability: Only three production geometries confound N, level counts, preconditioner and LSMR iteration counts4 versus10.
Sparse MAP exhaustion is censored; the exact MAP bound is not an LSMR iteration predictor.
Rollback copy, overlapping storage, complete setup/cleanup, and a reusable-cache lifecycle were not implemented or priced.
Prior and current hosts differ; one traced call per cell cannot fit a reliable host cost model.
decision.missing_diagnostic_decision: A separately predeclared same-host phase calibration would vary N,RHS width and geometry/preconditioner independently; price the complete candidate upper cost (geometry+copy+setup+four sweeps+certificate) against an unavoidable Auto setup lower cost, with frozen uncertainty and abstention. If setup-only dominance admits no case, a cold-LSMR predictor needs a separate declaration. No fitted coefficients are inferred here.

limitations: No scientific tolerance, sample, rank, omission, separation, independent certificate or route was changed.
No weighted geometry claim. Extra pairwise intersections cannot be removed to improve the bound.
All timing gains/costs are diagnostic observations; Mac remains the performance qualification host.
Original raw logs and task paths are omitted; source/result/log/accounting hashes retain their identities.
